sentences.text: The appellant has deposited deficit court fee vide covering memo no.1217 dated 16.02.2023 and prays for taking the same on record.
Accordingly, deficit court fee is taken on record.

This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimant being aggrieved of award dated 16th April, 2021 passed by the learned IInd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Satna (M.P.) in Motor Claim Case No.229/2018 on the ground that learned Tribunal for an accident, which took place on 18.11.2016 has construed the income of the claimant as Rs.4500/- per month in place of minimum wages on the date of accident to the tune of Rs.6950/- per month and therefore, Tribunal have erred in computing the compensation.

entities.text: IInd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Satna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Vinod Kumar Tripathi- Advocate for respondent/Insurance Company supports the award and opposes the appeal.
Learned Tribunal has admitted 20% permanent disability and has awarded compensation in accordance with the said disability.

When income is taken Rs.6950/- per month or Rs.83,400/- per annum then 20% of this will come out to Rs.16,680/- per annum and when multiplier of 17 as is applied by the Tribunal is applied then claimant will be entitled to a sum of Rs.2,83,560/- under the head of loss of income in place of Rs.1,83,600/-
Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.99,960/- under this head.
In addition, the claimant will be entitled to future prospect @ 40%, that will come out to Rs.1,39,944/-.

Beside this the Tribunal has considered loss of income @ Rs.4,500/- per month for a period of 6 months and has awarded a sum of Rs.25,000/-, whereas @Rs.6950/- per month this amount is to be computed and that will come out to Rs.41,700/-.

Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs16,700/-
under this head also.
Thus, there will be total enhancement to the tune of Rs1,56,644/- in addition t o the amount awarded by learned Claims Tribunal.

This additional amount will also earn interest at the rate of 6% per annum, as has been awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal, from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of actual payment.
Other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
In above terms, this miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE tarun Rajend Kumar Kushwah vs Rakesh Kumar Yadav on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160329528/
